Crew guide · All

Turn a ruck into shared learning

A repeatable after-action process for the entire crew.

Review · corrective actions

Establish the plan

Before departure, agree what success means and what would trigger a change.

  1. Record the intended route, load options, roles and regroup points.
  2. Name one skill or behaviour the group intends to practise.
  3. Keep the plan short enough that everyone can understand it.

Compare plan with reality

Describe what happened before debating why it happened.

  1. Ask what changed, when people noticed, and what decision followed.
  2. Separate direct observations from assumptions.
  3. Include the perspectives of the front, back and less experienced participants.

Choose corrective actions

A useful review ends with something that can be tested.

  1. Identify one thing to keep, one to change and one question to investigate.
  2. Assign an owner, a due date and a simple success criterion.
  3. At the next session, check whether the change actually helped.

Share learning responsibly

Participants should be able to discuss mistakes without fearing public embarrassment.

  1. Keep private details out of group summaries unless people agree to share them.
  2. Use the Field Notes review tool for a local copy.
  3. Publish personal reports only with the author’s permission.
